title: Mob Scaling (staff)
body:
Syntax: mobscale | mobscale preview <level>
        mobscale <rank or range> <hp|damage|hitroll> <25-400>
        mobscale all <hp|damage|hitroll> <25-400>

Description: Each mob-level bracket independently stores HP, damage and hitroll percentages: Student 1-10, Genin 11-35, Chuunin 36-65, Special Jounin 66-200, Jounin 201-250. Example: mobscale genin hp 75; mobscale 36-65 damage 125; mobscale special jounin hitroll 110. Use mobscale to see all bands. Old global syntax (mobscale hp 100) and explicit ALL change that stat in every band. Existing global settings are copied into each band on upgrade, and saved in data/mob_balance.json. Newly spawned mobs use the updated balance; existing fights are unchanged. The fivefold HP baseline is unchanged. All nine Tailed Beasts and custom bosses retain their custom stats. Use mset <vnum> autobalance off to exempt a specific mob. Only administrators and Implementors may use mobscale.
